# Hash-pinned runtime dependencies (S-006).
# All third-party runtime deps of this repo: pycryptodome (AES decrypt) and
# zstandard (WAL/compressed row decompression). Everything else is stdlib.
# Hashes cover every published wheel + sdist for the pinned version so that
# `pip install --require-hashes -r requirements.txt` succeeds on any platform
# without allowing a substituted/unexpected artifact (supply-chain hardening).
